title: The Complete Geometric Saddle of the Colored Jones Finite Sum
content: The volume conjecture relates the growth of the colored Jones polynomial at roots of unity to hyperbolic volume. We identify the local expansion associated with the complete hyperbolic structure directly from an exact coefficient presentation of the finite Jones sum. For every hyperbolic knot, two coefficient mergers in a marked closed braid remove the degeneracies at the cut. The resulting phase has a nondegenerate complete geometric saddle after the common regional scale is fixed. Its critical value gives the complex volume, and its Gaussian coefficient is determined by meridian-normalized adjoint Reidemeister torsion. The remaining formal series agrees with the Dimofte–Garoufalidis series of the collapsed ideal triangulation up to an explicit factor exp(ch), where 24c ∈ Z and h = 2πi/N. The contribution of this local expansion to the full Jones evaluation depends on the original coefficient contour.
